title: Seagrove Beach "8 Degrees of Separation" 45 Sea Walk Circle
h1: Seagrove Beach "8 Degrees of Separation" 45 Sea Walk Circle
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Beach front- Gulf views- Private beach access- Private pool with sitting spa *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $45 per day- 6 Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Peloton- Outdoor kitchen- High-end appliances- 2 Laundry rooms- 8 adult bikes- ILVE Custom hood range- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 4 beach chairs with 2 umbrellas (Mar 1-Oct 31)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Some homes simply define coastal luxury, offering a spectacular Gulf-front location, exquisite Mediterranean design, and everyone’s favorite amenities. So it is with 45 Sea Walk Circle in the heart of Seagrove Beach. This newly constructed 8-bedroom, 5.5-bath Gulf-front getaway features a private pool and sitting spa—as well as a private beach walkover that leads to more than 50 feet of private waterfront. All of the excitement of Seaside is just a short drive away. This 3-story, 4,395-square-foot luxury vacation home sleeps up to 25 guests. The gourmet kitchen is located on the first floor and features Viking appliances, designer cabinets, and beautiful custom countertops. The wine chiller is always nearby. The island counter offers abundant counter seating and opens onto the dining area. Adjacent is the living room with its sweeping views of the Gulf and cozy seating before an expansive TV. Simply put, it’s the perfect venue for vacation movie night. Just steps away is the spectacular outdoor living space with a covered patio, private pool, sitting spa, and outdoor kitchen with a grill. Lounge poolside with a cocktail or stroll down to the turquoise waters of the Gulf. It’s all right there. Ascending to the second floor, guests will find the primary bedroom with a king bed, a beachside deck, and a private bath. Adjacent are 2 guest bedrooms—one with a king bed, a beachside deck, and a private bath, while the other has a king bed, a northside deck, and a shared bath. Steps away is a bunk room with 3 twin-over-full bunk beds and a shared bath.The third floor has another primary bedroom with a beachside balcony, king bed, and a private bath. Down the hall are 2 guest bedrooms, both with queen beds and shared bathrooms. Adjacent is a bedroom/office with a queen Murphy bed and a shared bathroom. An additional sleeping area offers a full sleeper sofa with a kitchenette. Nearby is a laundry area to keep the beach wardrobe fresh. This gorgeous Alaya Collection home has 1 garage and 3 outside parking spaces. It also comes with a 6-passenger low speed vehicle and 8 adult bikes. Book 45 Sea Walk Circle in Seagrove Beach today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 25):SECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed with Beachside Deck, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed with Beachside Deck, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed with Northside Deck, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: 1 Twin-over-Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed and 1 Full-over-Full-over-Full Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed with Beachside Balcony, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom/Office: Queen Murphy Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Additional Sleeping Area: Full Sleeper Sofa with Kitchenette*Please note that there is construction going on in multiple locations on the street.*Unfortunately, the fireplace and "Green Egg" smoker are not for guest use.
